retrievalProfile.description: A stark, high-contrast black and white close-up portrait with minimalist sans-serif typography positioned at the top corners against a pure white background.
excludeWhen: busy or environmental backgrounds are needed
centered or decorative display type is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, centered headshot in grayscale featuring sharp detail and visible skin texture, set against a blown-out white background with wide-tracked sans-serif text placed in the upper left and right margins.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered horizontally with eyes as the primary focal point
High-key white background contrasting with deep shadows in the subject's features
Symmetrical typographic placement balancing the top edge of the frame
Tight cropping that emphasizes facial expression and texture
coreInvariants: Pure white background (#FFFFFF) with no environmental detail
Grayscale color mode with high tonal contrast

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, large-scale headshot occupying approximately 80% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes to the top-left text, across to the top-right text, then down to the facial texture.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space surrounding the head and at the top corners where text resides.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for stark isolation.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and mid-tone grays within the subject's hair and shadows.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for both corner elements to maintain symmetry.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric clarity and modern feel.
Open-source alternative with similar geometric proportions.
Classic geometric sans that fits the minimalist aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, black and white close-up portrait of a person centered against a pure white background. Ensure sharp focus on skin texture and eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two strings of text in a geometric sans-serif font, all caps, with wide tracking. Place one string in the top-left corner and the other in the top-right corner, ensuring they are small and balanced.

verificationChecks: Is the text all-caps with wide tracking?
Is the portrait centered and tightly cropped?

postGenerationChecks: Check for pure white background isolation
Ensure no color artifacts are present
Confirm symmetrical corner placement of text
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W portrait + pure white background + wide-tracked geometric sans-serif in top corners.
